Example public-interest report

By the reporter

Community members described how policy decisions affected their homes, employment, and health. Researchers collected interviews, verified details against public records, and explained the surrounding context without relying on embedded widgets. The report follows several families through different decisions while preserving the distinct voices of the people involved.
